description.value: Eggette is a Hong Kong-style bubble waffle shop on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, part of the Eggette House brand founded by young Vancouver entrepreneurs. The menu features creative eggette flavors such as salted egg yolk, Portuguese egg tart, black sesame, and double chocolate, alongside hand-made bean cubes and Hong Kong-style milk tea. A compact dessert-focused stop that could serve as a quick snack break for cyclists passing through the West End.
